title: PrismCrawl Yelp API input
description: Look up Yelp businesses by keyword and location, and collect complete Yelp reviews, through the PrismCrawl API as structured JSON. You need a PrismCrawl API key; each successful request uses one PrismCrawl credit, and failed requests are free.

prismcrawlApiKey.title: PrismCrawl API key
prismcrawlApiKey.description: Your PrismCrawl API key, sent to PrismCrawl as the x-api-key header. Create or rotate it in the PrismCrawl dashboard; new accounts get 100 free credits. The key is stored encrypted by Apify and is never logged or written to the dataset.

mode.title: What to fetch
mode.description: Look up businesses by keyword and location, or fetch the reviews of one business.

query.title: Search query
query.description: For business lookup: what to search for, such as restaurants.

location.title: Location
location.description: For business lookup: where to search, such as Austin, TX. Use either a location or coordinates.

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: For business lookup: latitude to search around, instead of a location. Set together with longitude.

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: Longitude, for example -76.6122. Set together with latitude.

id.title: Business alias
id.description: For reviews: the business alias from its Yelp URL, such as halcyon-austin-2.

sort_by.title: Review order
sort_by.description: For reviews: the order to return them in.

maxPages.title: Maximum pages
maxPages.description: How many pages to fetch (one page of businesses or reviews each). The Actor stops early when PrismCrawl reports there is no next page. Each page is a separate PrismCrawl request and uses one credit.

page.title: First page
page.description: One-based page to start from. Business lookup covers the first 200 businesses.

limit.title: Items per page
limit.description: Businesses or reviews per page (1–100). Business lookup defaults to 20.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language code supported by the provider, such as en.

device.title: Device
device.description: Device presentation used for the source request. Leave empty for the default.

zero_trace.title: Zero trace
zero_trace.description: When enabled, PrismCrawl does not store the source or parsed response for these requests; only audit and billing metadata is kept. Results still appear in this Actor's dataset.
